aarti.tek: Victory to you, Śani Deva, victory to you, Śani Deva;
victory, victory, victory to you, Śani Deva.
In all creation, crores upon crores
aarti.pad1: Lord, whoever you are angry with
his wealth, splendour, honour and fame
King Nala came under Śani’s period,
and it took away his kingdom and throne.
aarti.pad2: Lord, whoever you are pleased with
who in the world can trouble such a one —
the devotees who serve you with copper, oil and sesame?
aarti.pad3: the world rings with cries of victory to you.
In the Kali age, the greatness of Śani Deva
Let me perform the āratī with loving devotion
and offer dried fruits as my gift.
